mapper.select: select distinct sm.* from system_menu sm inner join role_menu srm on sm.id = srm.menu_id inner join user_role sur on srm.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id = #{userId} and srm.deleted = 0 and sur.deleted = 0 and sm.deleted = 0 and sm.type != 'BUTTON' order by sm.order_sort asc
select distinct sr.role_key from role_info sr inner join user_role sur on sr.id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id = #{userId} and sur.deleted = 0 and sr.deleted = 0

select distinct sm.permission from system_menu sm inner join role_menu srm on sm.id = srm.menu_id inner join user_role sur on srm.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id = #{userId} and srm.deleted = 0 and sur.deleted = 0 and sm.deleted = 0
